description: No clean concept found. It tends to fire in quiet early-to-middle positions where column 1 (second from left) holds 1-2 stones, column 0 is shorter than column 1 (usually empty), and columns 2-3 have stones, so the column-1 landing cell is on row 1 or 2. It never fires when column 1 is empty, full or 3 high, but most positions with that shape do not fire, and its strength depends on details elsewhere on the board.
effect: Small: it slightly suppresses column 1. Zeroing it raises column 1 by about 4-16 points; forcing it to max lowers column 1 by 1-8 points.
notes: Hypotheses: column-1/column-0 geometry (necessary but far from sufficient); a threat cell just above the column-1 landing cell (rejected with a minimal pair); column 1 being a bad move by teacher scores (no). Best dev F1 0.164 (P 0.11, R 0.32, AUROC 0.64), simulation share -0.08. Activation is fragile: adding almost any two stones to firing openings turns it off. Possibly a mixture or random direction. Synthesis positions reach 8.95 against a dev max of 7.12.
